hint.offline: Syncing needs a connection. Your changes are saved on this device.

offline.title: Offline
offline.message: You can keep using your vault. Your changes are saved on this device and will be sent when the connection is back.

session.title: Your session has expired
session.message: Your data is still here; sign in to sync again.

upgrade.title: Update AccioPass
upgrade.web: This version can no longer connect to the server. Your vault is still available on this device, but it will not sync until you update. Reload the page to load the new version; you will need to unlock again afterwards.
upgrade.native: This version can no longer connect to the server. Your vault is still available on this device, but it will not sync until you update. Install the latest version from the app store.

restricted.termsTitle: Accept the new Terms and Conditions to carry on
restricted.terms: They came into force on {date} and you have not accepted them yet.
restricted.termsNoDate: They are in force and you have not accepted them yet.
restricted.stillWorks: In the meantime you can view and copy your passwords and codes, export your data and delete the account. You cannot add, change or share anything.

pending.one: {count} change is saved on this device only: it will be sent when the account is back to normal.
pending.other: {count} changes are saved on this device only: they will be sent when the account is back to normal.

legal.titleTerms: We have updated the Terms and Conditions
legal.titlePrivacy: We have updated the Privacy Policy
legal.titleBoth: We have updated the Terms and the Privacy Policy
legal.whatChanged: What changes is in the documents themselves. Read them before you decide.
legal.effective: They come into force on {date}. If you have not accepted them by then, your account will be read-only until you do: you will be able to view, export and delete the account, but not to add or change anything.
legal.overdue: They came into force on {date}. Your account is read-only until you accept them.
legal.overdueNoDate: They are in force. Your account is read-only until you accept them.
legal.acceptingTerms: By pressing "Accept" you accept the new version of the Terms and Conditions.
legal.acceptingPrivacy: By pressing "Accept" you confirm that you have read the new version of the Privacy Policy. It is information about your data, not consent.
legal.acceptingBoth: By pressing "Accept" you accept the new version of the Terms and Conditions and confirm that you have read that of the Privacy Policy.
legal.disagree: If you do not agree, you can export your data and delete the account in Settings.
legal.changedAgain: The documents changed again while you were reading them. Review them once more before accepting.

otherTab.title: AccioPass is open in another tab
otherTab.message: The vault can only be open in one tab at a time, so that no change is lost. This one has been locked.
otherTab.hint: The other tab will lock, and you will need to unlock again here.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this screen
crash.message: We could not show it. Your data is still saved and encrypted on this device: nothing was lost.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.message: The link may be incomplete, or what you were looking for may have been deleted.

recoveryReminder.title: Generate your recovery words
recoveryReminder.message: You verified your e-mail at a different time from signing up, so we could not show you the recovery words. Without them you cannot recover the account if you forget the master password. Generate new ones in Settings > Security > Recovery words.
recoveryReminder.unconfirmedTitle: Your recovery words are not confirmed
recoveryReminder.unconfirmedMessage: The last recovery words generated on this device were never confirmed: the page was reloaded or locked first. If you did not write them down, the ones you hold may no longer work, and you could not recover the account if you forget the master password. Generate new ones and confirm them in Settings > Security > Recovery words.
